def transform(grid):
    left=[row[:4] for row in grid]
    right=[row[5:9] for row in grid]
    overlap=any(left[r][c] and right[r][c] for r in range(4) for c in range(4))
    if overlap:
        return left
    return [[left[r][c] or right[r][c] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
